name: Departed Loved Ones
overview: Scripture assures believers that those who trust in Christ will not perish but have eternal life, emphasizing God's great love in giving His Son (John 3:16). Jesus affirms the security of His followers, stating that no one can snatch them from the Father's hand (John 10:29), highlighting the eternal protection and care God provides. Furthermore, Romans 14:8 reminds us that whether we live or die, we belong to the Lord, underscoring the believer's continuous union with Christ beyond physical death.
